lead: Won Hemet's citywide pavement rehabilitation contract ($2,118,000, about 389,000 sq ft), including full-depth reclamation on East Menlo Ave from San Jacinto St to Park Ave and other streets.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 23, 2026 (Hemet City Council award). Hemet is about 15-20 miles from the yard. Full-depth reclamation recycles the road in place, so pitch dumping for excess grindings, curb and gutter, and base for patches and widening on the streets that are milled and overlaid instead. Ask for the project manager and the start date.
